verdict.rationale: Trello documents a REST API with auth, batch, search and webhooks, but no evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable spec. A probe of common OpenAPI/Swagger paths on the developer site returned 404 everywhere. Human-readable REST docs and an MCP server are adjacent capabilities, not a downloadable spec, so they earn no credit; confidence is medium because the probe only checked guessed paths.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
